title: Bangalore Property Guide: Homes & Localities | Trusted Properties
description: Find Bangalore homes and plots with Trusted Properties. Compare localities, explore developer projects and use practical guides for buying or renting.
heading: Find your property in Bangalore
intro: Start with the part of Bangalore that fits your everyday life. Trusted Properties brings together purchase project guides from SOBHA, Puravankara, Provident and DNR Group, with a separate guide for people planning to rent. Bangalore and Bengaluru refer to the same city throughout this site.
sections:
Buying a home or looking for a rental?

For a purchase, compare the location, configuration, size definitions, indicative price and project phase before arranging a visit. Our property catalogue is for purchase research. For a rental, start with a monthly budget, move-in date and commute; the rental guide explains what to ask an owner or agent. This website does not currently publish live rental listings.

Choose a locality before choosing a project

Whitefield, Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and North Bangalore cover different addresses and travel routes. A broad locality name does not tell you how long the last part of your journey will take. Check the exact project entrance, visit at the times you normally travel and consider access to shops, schools and everyday services.

Compare the full picture

Keep a shortlist with the source date, developer, project phase, configuration and total quoted cost. A lower starting price can refer to a different size or exclude charges. Project cards on this site link to detailed guides and their sources; use those details to prepare questions, then request current information before deciding.

Your questions

What is Trusted Properties in Bangalore?

Trusted Properties is an independent property information and enquiry platform featuring purchase projects from multiple developers in Bengaluru. It is not an official developer website. Project prices are indicative and availability must be confirmed.

title: Properties for Rent in Bangalore: Rental Guide | Trusted Properties
description: Planning to rent in Bangalore? Compare localities, BHK sizes, furnishing, monthly costs and viewing checks. A practical guide, without live rental listings.
heading: Properties for rent in Bangalore: a practical guide
intro: Looking for a flat, independent house or villa for rent in Bangalore? Use this guide to organise your search and compare homes on the same basis. Trusted Properties currently publishes purchase project guides, not live rental listings or confirmed rental availability.
sections:
Start with the commute and move-in date

Write down your workplace or campus, usual travel times and desired move-in date before shortlisting. Compare the exact address rather than a broad area label. Test the route during your normal commute and check the walk, bus or auto journey from any station you expect to use. Ask whether the home will actually be vacant by your proposed date.

Choose the size and furnishing you need

For a 1 BHK, 2 BHK or 3 BHK flat, check how the rooms work for your household, storage and working from home. Furnished, semi-furnished and unfurnished can mean different things in different listings. Ask for an itemised list of beds, wardrobes, appliances and fittings, with their condition recorded at handover. For houses and villas, check who maintains outdoor areas and shared facilities.

Compare monthly and move-in costs separately

Your recurring budget should include rent, maintenance, parking, utilities and any services you plan to use. Your move-in budget should separately record the refundable deposit, any agreed brokerage, moving costs and furniture or appliance purchases. Ask what is included in each quote and when payments fall due. This guide does not quote market rents because they vary by home and require current listing evidence.

Questions to ask before visiting

Confirm the exact unit, floor, available date, furnishing inventory, parking arrangement, water supply and backup power. Ask about any household, pet, visitor or move-in rules that affect you. Request recent photos of that unit and confirm that the person arranging the viewing can show it. Keep a comparison sheet so a low advertised rent does not hide extra recurring charges.

Record the agreement and handover details

Discuss the tenancy term, notice period, proposed rent changes, deposit return, repair responsibilities and any charges for leaving early. Read the written terms before committing and get advice for clauses you do not understand. At handover, record meter readings, keys, existing damage and the condition of the agreed furnishing; retain dated photographs and payment receipts.

Use the official transport source

Check current Namma Metro routes and passenger information with BMRCL, then test the last stretch between the station and the home. A planned connection should not be treated as an operating service. The source below is for transport checks; it does not verify any rental listing.

Your questions

Are there live rental properties on Trusted Properties?

No live rental inventory is published on this website at present. This page is a rental planning guide. The project catalogue and enquiry form are for purchase projects; purchase guide prices are not monthly rents.

How should I compare flats for rent in Bangalore?

Compare the exact address, BHK size, furnishing inventory, availability date, rent, maintenance, deposit, parking and any agreed brokerage. Check the commute and inspect the actual unit before committing.

Official sources

  • BMRCL: official Namma Metro information

title: Properties in Whitefield, Bangalore | Trusted Properties
description: Compare SOBHA One World and Provident Botanico around Whitefield, Bangalore. Explore sourced configurations, locations, guide prices and project details.
heading: Properties in Whitefield and Greater Whitefield
intro: Explore purchase projects listed around Whitefield and Greater Whitefield in the developer guides. SOBHA One World is described at Greater Whitefield on Old Madras Road; Provident Botanico is listed on Soukya Road, Whitefield. These are different addresses, so compare the exact route that matters to you.
sections:
Compare the two project addresses

The Whitefield label covers more than one location in this collection. Do not assume that an Old Madras Road address and a Soukya Road address share the same commute or station access. Request a location pin for the project entrance, then visit the approach roads and test your workplace route.

Shortlist by configuration and cost

The SOBHA One World guide lists 1, 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes, while Provident Botanico lists 2 and 3 BHK homes. Check each project page for its own sizes and pricing basis. These are guide configurations rather than a claim that every layout is currently available. Request a quotation for the exact unit and phase you are considering.

Check transport against current information

Use the official BMRCL information to check operating routes and stations, then verify how you would reach the station from the project. This page makes no promise about station distance or journey time. An on-site visit also lets you assess everyday access, building work nearby and the surroundings.

Official sources

  • BMRCL: current Metro information

title: Sarjapur Road & Nearby Bangalore Properties | Trusted Properties
description: Explore SOBHA Altair off Sarjapura Road and nearby Panathur and Bellandur projects. Compare each Bangalore address, configuration and sourced project guide.
heading: Sarjapur Road and nearby East Bangalore properties
intro: Start with SOBHA Altair, listed off Sarjapura Road beside Royal Pavilion, then compare nearby East Bangalore options in Panathur and Bellandur. Each project card gives its actual guide location; nearby projects are not presented as being on Sarjapur Road itself.
sections:
Separate Sarjapur Road from nearby addresses

SOBHA Neopolis is listed on Silver Oaks Main Road off Panathur Road, SOBHA Ayana on Panathur Road, and DNR Arista on Bellandur Main Road along the Marathahalli–Sarjapur Outer Ring Road corridor. Use the exact entrance location to compare these projects. A nearby neighbourhood name is not a substitute for a journey test.

Match the layout to the household

The guide lists 3 and 4 BHK homes at Altair, 1, 3 and 4 BHK homes at Neopolis, 3 BHK homes at Ayana, and 2, 3 and 4 BHK homes at DNR Arista. Compare size definitions, the floor plan and current inventory before treating a configuration as an available option. DNR pricing is on request in this catalogue.

Make the site visit useful

Check the approach roads at your usual travel time, the practical route to your workplace and access to daily essentials. At the project, ask about the specific phase, construction status, approved plans and the itemised cost sheet. Compare the source-linked project guides below before arranging visits.

title: Properties in North Bangalore: Homes & Plots | Trusted Properties
description: Compare North Bangalore apartments, villaments and plots at Purva Atmosphere, Provident Ecopolitan, Deansgate and SOBHA Chartered Birdsong.
heading: Homes and plots in North Bangalore
intro: North Bangalore options in this collection include Purva Atmosphere near Manyata Business Park, Provident Ecopolitan at Aerospace Park, Provident Deansgate on IVC Road and SOBHA Chartered Birdsong off Rajanakunte. Compare the property type as well as the location.
sections:
Four addresses, different daily routes

An address near Manyata Business Park, one at Aerospace Park, one on IVC Road and one off Rajanakunte should be assessed separately. Check the actual entrance and test routes to your workplace, school or other regular destinations. This page does not assume that every North Bangalore project offers the same airport access or commuting time.

Apartment, villament or residential plot?

Atmosphere and Ecopolitan are apartment projects in the catalogue. Deansgate lists 3 BHK villaments with garden and terrace options described in its guide. Chartered Birdsong is a plotted development. Comparing a plot price per square foot with an apartment total price will not give an equivalent budget; compare the applicable costs and intended use for each.

Check phase and source before shortlisting

Completion information in a brochure can vary by phase. Review the individual source, ask which phase your quotation covers and request current availability. For a plot, discuss the applicable layout, infrastructure and building conditions; for a home, review the exact floor plan, size definitions and handover specifications.

title: Properties in HSR Layout, Bangalore | Trusted Properties
description: Compare SOBHA Infinia and Purva Meraki in HSR Layout, Bangalore. Explore 3 and 4 BHK guide configurations, project locations and indicative purchase prices.
heading: Properties in HSR Layout, Bangalore
intro: Compare two purchase projects listed in HSR Layout: SOBHA Infinia and Purva Meraki. Both guides include 3 and 4 BHK configurations. Purva Meraki is described near Somasundarapalya Lake; confirm the exact location and unit details before planning a visit.
sections:
Compare the exact residence

A shared neighbourhood and BHK label do not mean identical layouts. Look at bedroom dimensions, storage, balconies, workspaces and the usable area definitions in each floor plan. Compare the specific configuration and floor being quoted rather than the project starting price alone.

Check the surroundings in person

Visit the project entrance and surrounding streets to assess everyday access, traffic, shops and the routes you expect to use. A location described near a lake does not establish a guaranteed view from a unit. Ask about the applicable site plans and inspect the actual orientation for any view-related decision.

Ask for a complete quotation

Use the source-linked guides below for initial research, then request the latest itemised cost sheet, phase information and current inventory. Prices, specifications and availability should be checked for the particular home. The buying checklist helps you organise those questions before a booking decision.

title: Residential Plots in Bangalore | Trusted Properties
description: Compare SOBHA Sacred Grove at Chikka Tirupati and Chartered Birdsong off Rajanakunte. Review sourced plot sizes, locations and indicative per-square-foot rates.
heading: Residential plots in Bangalore
intro: Explore the two plotted communities in the catalogue: SOBHA Sacred Grove at Chikka Tirupati and SOBHA Chartered Birdsong off Rajanakunte. The source guides quote plot rates per square foot, rather than an all-inclusive price for every plot.
sections:
Compare plot sizes and locations

Sacred Grove lists 1,200–1,650 sq ft plots plus odd sizes. Chartered Birdsong lists 1,200–3,000 sq ft plots plus odd sizes. Check the exact dimensions, plot number and layout position in the current offer. These guide ranges do not confirm which plots remain available.

Turn a quoted rate into a useful budget

Ask for the area and rate applicable to the particular plot, then request the complete payable cost and a separate explanation of other charges. A per-square-foot guide rate is not the total purchase cost. Consider the future building budget separately if your plan is to construct a home.

Review the applicable documents

Ask for the approved layout, access and infrastructure information, the specific project phase and the documents needed to check the plot. Use the official Karnataka RERA portal for the corresponding project record. Arrange independent professional review of the title and transaction documents before relying on them; a listing on this website is not a certification.

Official sources

  • Karnataka RERA: official project and agent information

title: Bangalore Property Buying Checklist | Trusted Properties
description: Prepare for a Bangalore property purchase: compare exact addresses, floor plans, itemised costs, project phases, source documents and questions for site visits.
heading: A Bangalore property buying checklist
intro: Use this checklist to turn a property shortlist into clear questions for the developer. It applies to the purchase guides on Trusted Properties. Project brochures help with initial research; the specific unit, current quotation and applicable documents determine what you are actually considering.
sections:
1. Record the exact property and phase

Write down the project, developer, entrance address, phase, tower or plot number and proposed configuration. Keep the source brochure and note when you received the quotation. Confirm whether the completion information relates to that phase rather than another part of the project.

2. Compare plans and size definitions

Ask for the applicable floor plan and an explanation of the areas quoted. Check room sizes, storage, ventilation, balconies and any parking allocation against your needs. Do not compare two size figures unless their definitions match. For plots, check the plot dimensions and position in the applicable layout.

3. Request the full cost sheet

Ask for an itemised quotation for the exact unit or plot and identify which charges are included in the advertised price. Record the payment schedule, any stated validity period and conditions attached to an offer. Keep purchase costs separate from future maintenance, furnishing and construction budgets.

4. Review the corresponding project record

Find the applicable project and phase on the official Karnataka RERA portal and compare the identity with the documents supplied to you. The portal provides project and agent status services. Arrange independent legal or other professional review where needed; a project card or brochure does not verify the title, approvals or your contract.

5. Inspect the route and site

Test the approach route during your usual travel time. At the visit, ask which spaces are completed, proposed or part of another phase. Distinguish a show home or artist’s impression from the specifications for your unit. Note questions about water, power, parking, access and the responsibilities for common areas.

6. Keep written answers before deciding

Retain the current quotation, plans, document copies and written replies to important questions. Ask about the booking terms, cancellation conditions and handover process before making a commitment. If answers change your budget or expectations, compare the shortlist again instead of relying on the original starting price.

No. Prices are indicative information from linked developer guides and project sources. Request the latest itemised cost sheet and confirm availability, phase details and specifications for the property you are considering.
